2607.28439.title: Beyond a Single Judge: Simulating Social Persona Panels for Generative UI Evaluation
2607.28439.paper_summary: Generative UI (GenUI) lets large language models synthesize a complete, renderable interface directly from a natural-language instruction, but evaluating the quality of what they generate remains an open problem. Human evaluation is costly and rater-variant, while LLM-as-a-judge is scalable but reflects only a single implicit viewpoint, unable to capture how different populations of real users actually perceive the same interface. We propose the Evidence-Grounded, Social-Weighted Persona Panel (ESPP), a three-stage GenUI evaluation method in which a panel of psychologically diverse, evidence-grounded personas independently rates a screenshot, exchanges opinions under a trait-derived, semantically-gated bounded-confidence mechanism, and is aggregated via Delphi-inspired social weighting into a single judgment. ESPP tracks human judgment substantially more closely than a naive single-pass judge, raising Pearson $r$ from $0.716$ to $0.922$, and a prompt-ensemble control recovers only about a third of this gap, isolating genuine persona and evidence grounding as the dominant source of improvement. Beyond this fidelity gain, retaining each panelist's individual rating further reveals that user subgroups agree on overall model rankings yet diverge sharply on specific rating dimensions, a structural disagreement a single homogeneous judge would systematically erase. The codes are available at https://github.com/Wuzheng02/ESPP.
2607.28439.paper_summary_zh: 生成式 UI (GenUI) 使大型語言模型能夠直接從自然語言指令合成完整的可渲染介面，但評估其生成品質仍然是一個未解決的問題。人工評估成本高且評分者變異性大，而將 LLM 作為評判者則具有可擴展性，但僅反映單一隱含觀點，無法捕捉不同實際用戶群體對同一介面的不同感知。我們提出了基於證據的社會加權角色小組 (ESPP)，這是一種三階段的 GenUI 評估方法，其中一組心理多樣、基於證據的角色獨立評分截圖，在基於特徵衍生的語義閘控有界信心機制下交換意見，並通過類德爾菲的社會加權聚合為單一判斷。ESPP 在人類判斷上顯著更接近於天真的單次評判者，將 Pearson $r$ 從 $0.716$ 提高到 $0.922$，而提示集成控制僅回收了這一差距的約三分之一，將真正的角色和證據基礎隔離為主要的改進來源。除了這一忠實度的提升外，保留每位小組成員的個別評分進一步揭示用戶子群體在整體模型排名上達成一致，但在具體評分維度上卻出現明顯分歧，這種結構性的分歧將被單一同質評判者系統性地抹去。代碼可在 https://github.com/Wuzheng02/ESPP 獲得。
